question.description: The observation that chat-level accuracy hides shift-level failure, and how the benchmark measures it.

findings.description: Three findings: failures concentrate in inherited work, one cross-item error explains most of them, and it is not a length effect.

evidence.description: The same failure in other forms, the control that rules out harder items, and the results.

validity.description: Why the failures are the model's, what is not yet shown, and the next experiment.
